command: npm test && npm run demo && python scripts/validate.py (after python -m pip install -r requirements-validation.txt)

tests.detail: jwplayer reached READY via Recognizer -> Decision -> private Procedure -> Validator.
jwplayer + videojs returned NEEDS_INPUT without guessing.
hls.js fixture catalog produced READY with hlsjs.extract.v1.
All five DIS 0.1.0 JSON Schemas passed Draft 2020-12 meta-schema checks.
All six demo Intelligence Units validated against the Unit Schema.
Composition Graph, Domain Definition and Resource Closure validated.
All 16 inputs across the four executed demo paths validated against the executing Unit input Schema.
All 16 outputs across the four executed demo paths validated against the executing Unit output Schema.
Traversal, empty segment, dot segment, remote URI, absolute path and backslash references were rejected.
Nested Graph pointers were rejected under the explicit DIS 0.1.0 top-level pointer profile.
All nine schema resources matched the manifest SHA-256 values; tampering was rejected.
Private Procedures remained private and were not represented as Tool Components.
Recognizer evidence reached Validator through a dedicated evidence edge, independent of Decision and Procedure outputs.

findings.description: Initial Edge combined control routing and data mapping, forcing upstream payload pass-through.
findings.resolution: Replaced with mutually exclusive control, data and evidence edge kinds; verified independent execution and evidence flow.

findings.description: Initial schemaRef validation accepted unresolved schema resource strings.
findings.resolution: Added package-relative closure resolution, nested local $ref traversal, path safety, digest manifest and fail-closed negative tests.

findings.description: Decision and Procedure output Schemas contradicted the separated data/evidence runtime behavior.
findings.resolution: Corrected output Schemas and validated every executed Node input and output against its declared Unit Schema.

findings.description: Validation Report Schema contained invalid JSON syntax.
findings.resolution: Corrected the schema and included it in five-schema Draft 2020-12 self-validation.

findings.description: The previous safe-path patterns did not reject empty and dot path segments.
findings.resolution: Aligned Unit, Graph, Definition and Resource Closure path patterns and added negative cases.

findings.description: Unit Evidence referenced fixture catalogs that the demo implementation did not actually consume.
findings.resolution: Recognizer and Procedure now load and consume the package fixture catalogs; a fixture-backed HLS path is tested.
